newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Greenfields Coal says appoints joint M.D.
newsitem.headline: Greenfields Coal says appoints joint M.D.

text.p: Greenfields Coal Co Ltd, the subject of a share-swap takeover offer by Canada's Mineral Resources Corp (MRC), said on Tuesday it has appointed Stephen Barber as chief executive officer and joint managing director.

Greenfields said Barber, who was appointed a director last month, was experienced in resource sector corporate transactions, particularly in the United States, and was currently negotiating finance and sale contracts for its company's new plant in West Virginia.
The company said it also has appointed former Price Waterhouse partner Anthony Gall as a non-executive director and deputy chairman.
Stuart Nicol, formerly with the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, has been appointed as senior technical consultant and adviser.
Greenfields last week said MRC's offer of one of its shares for every eight Greenfields' shares appeared to grossly undervalue the company.
Greenfields owns the Alpheus coal reclamation plant in West Virginia, which has contracts to supply US Steel and has forecast annual output of 240,000 tons of clean coal.
